method: Candidate 10's draft (L2) can propose only token ids below 65,536, which covers most English, code and JSON tokens but not most Chinese or Japanese ones. Run 2 measures English prose only. This streams the same greedy prompts (English, Chinese, Japanese; thinking off) to one server and reports per language the block-aware decode (completion tokens - K) / (last event - first event), median of 3 reps after 1 warm-up, with the share of the output's token ids at or above 65,536 (the output re-tokenized by the model's tokenizer). Run once against candidate 10 (run 1) and once against production candidate 9, it gives each engine's CJK/English decode ratio.
